run_train_net: run the Caffe2 video training pipeline with argparse CLI arguments for model training
build_train_model: build a Caffe2 CNNModelHelper with data parallel GPU training and momentum-SGD parameter updates
test_model_evaluation: test the trained model by running inference on test data and computing accuracy or AUC metrics
save_model_checkpoint: save the trained Caffe2 model to a minidb checkpoint file at the end of each epoch
run_training_epoch: run a single training epoch with optional multi-label metric accumulation and logging
